name: sql_database

args.query:
CREATE TABLE cohort_summary AS 
SELECT cohorts.cohort_name, 
       COUNT(participants.participant_id) AS size, 
       GROUP_CONCAT(participants.contact_notes) AS example_comment 
FROM cohorts 
LEFT JOIN participants ON cohorts.cohort_id = participants.cohort_id 
GROUP BY cohorts.cohort_name;
